messages:
Sam (PM): Quick sync — we need to finalize the migration heatmap + launch gates for the upcoming catalog sweep. High-level ask: how do we default pin vs auto-swap for non-breaking model bumps? Thoughts?

Rina (Eng): +1. Propose default behavior: pin by default for any model where quality delta > 1% or latency change >10ms. Auto-swap only if regression <1% and cost improves >5%.

Jon (Research): For evals, we should use the existing regression suite + 3 customer baskets. Floor for rollout: pass all smoke parsers and quality delta within ±0.5% on CTR proxy.

Marta (CS): Customer perspective: we can't surprise large customers. Need an opt-in window and 30d notice for pinned models. For auto-swap, customers should get changelog + opt-out flag.

Eli (Product Ops): Proposed gates: canary (internal + 2 customers) 48h, 1% for 24h, 10% 72h, full. Each stage requires cost/latency/quality check. If any metric fails, rollback.

Nora (Solutions): For enterprise, add "migration hold" metadata so Sales can request freeze on specific model ids. Should surface in console with TTL.

Rina (Eng): Implementation notes: we can reuse rollout service. We'll need an API field: "pinning_policy": "pin|auto-swap|manual" and audit log entries. Also add a compatibility shim: fallback to previous version when incomplete tokenization changes detected.

Sam (PM): Action items: Rina to draft API schema + rollout flow, Jon to pick 3 baskets and run baseline by Fri, Marta to collate customers who need 30d notice, Eli to write rollout runbook. Agree on timelines?

Rina (Eng): timeline ack: API schema by Wed EOD. ETA for runtime change (fallback + logging) is 3 sprints unless we scope minimal.

Jon (Research): I'll run the evals on v2 vs v2-quant tonight. Share results in the thread.

Marta (CS): I'll start a customer comms doc and ping top 5 accounts. Need wording for "non-breaking upgrade" vs "behavioral change".

Eli (Product Ops): One more: add a deprecation tag with "sunset_date" and automatic migration suggestions. Provide migration heatmap UI: risk vs impact quadrant.

Sam (PM): Perfect. One open question: what's the default TTL for temporary pins? 90 days or 180? Thoughts?

Nora (Solutions): Recommend 90d default, with option to extend to 180 for enterprise contracts.

Rina (Eng): 90d default seems fine. Also need a mechanism for emergency unpin (admin override) with two-person approval.

Jon (Research): Slight nit: define how we calculate "quality delta" — use weighted AUC over seed prompts + human eval sample if near threshold.

Sam (PM): Noted. Let's meet Thurs 11am to lock decisions. I'll send calendar invite. :calendar:

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline trigger: rollout-playbook/migration-heatmap updated by Sam. CI: 24 checks run.

Sam (PM): Thanks. If no objections I’ll move this into the roadmap doc and create tickets.
